integrity: The full-support theorem is proved analytically; exact rational calculations are supplementary, not exhaustive evidence.
scientific_limitations: Finite-dimensional real strictly-positive diagonal weights only; exact worst-case complexity is weakly NP-complete for binary-encoded integer weights, not approximate hardness. A prior equivalent weighted-variance result may exist; no independent validation.
title: Sharp cross-norm stability and partition complexity of diagonal-quadratic simplex prediction
